claim: Cross-source sentiment divergence predicts ranking instability in multi-agent systems.
falsifier: Compute cross-source sentiment divergence and ranking instability in a multi-agent system and test the correlation.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported multi-agent system, 50 agents, hourly signals, and specific sentiment sources; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Cross-source sentiment divergence–ranking instability principle
